title: Cancel Hidden Roku and Streaming Add-ons
hook_text: YOU ARE PAYING FOR GHOST SUBSCRIPTIONS

beats.say: You are paying for three streaming services you haven't opened since last year.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a dark living room lit only by the cold blue glow of a television screen showing a static menu.

beats.say: Most people think their monthly streaming costs match their bank statements.
beats.visual: Close-up of hands holding a smartphone, scrolling past rows of tiny app icons in dim light.

beats.say: Where does that extra ten dollars a month actually vanish to?
beats.visual: Overhead shot of a coffee table with a remote control, a half-empty mug, and loose keys.

beats.say: You didn't sign up on their website. You clicked one button inside your streaming device.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a black thumb pressing a plastic button on a streaming remote.

beats.say: That single click linked your device account to invisible monthly billing.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a dark credit card resting on a wooden TV console.

beats.say: Let's find those hidden add-ons right now.
beats.visual: A person's silhouette standing near a glowing window at dusk, looking down at a phone.

beats.say: Step one. Grab your remote and open your Roku or streaming device settings.
beats.visual: Close-up of a finger tapping settings gear icon on a blurred TV interface.

beats.say: Step two. Go to user accounts and select subscriptions or billing history.
beats.visual: Side profile of a hand sliding down a smooth couch armrest holding a remote.

beats.say: Step three. Look past your main apps to find third-party channel add-ons.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a television screen showing a list of forgotten digital channels, softly blurred.

beats.say: A $15 a month forgotten subscription adds up to $1,800 over 10 years.
beats.visual: Close-up of a ceramic piggy bank sitting on a dark shelf, lit from the side.

beats.say: Cancel those ghost channels today and keep that cash in your actual pocket.
beats.visual: Slow panning shot across an empty wooden desk with clean, sharp architectural lighting.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Cinematic low-angle shot of a minimalist doorway leading into a warm, brightly lit room.

caption: Stop letting forgotten device add-ons quietly drain your bank account. Check your streaming device settings today. Follow for the money rules school never taught you. #PersonalFinance #MoneyTips #Budgeting #Streaming #SmartMoney
description: Eliminate overlooked video service add-ons billed through streaming devices in 3 simple steps. A 10-year subscription costs $1,800.
first_comment: How many ghost subscriptions did you find hiding in your device settings?

facts.basis: A $15/month subscription for 10 years = $1,800 from fact sheet.
